title: Quentin and the Debt
author: Rosalind Eriksen
blurb: Rafael Montrose, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
